Internal helper: a 100% stacked bar's legend, fitted to a look

Source: R/plot.R
dot-jst_plot_stacked_legend.Rd

The legend above the chart (ruling R68), from the picture's left edge: ggplot2 sets a legend above a chart from the left edge of the bars, so it is moved left by about the width of the bars' labels, which leaves it the picture's width. The move is reckoned a little short, so the legend never starts off the picture, and the room it is fitted to (.jst_plot_legend_fit()) is short by as much. Called when the chart is built and again when it is drawn in another style's look (.jst_plot_restyle()), whose text may be larger or whose figure narrower.

Usage

.jst_plot_stacked_legend(cats, legend_title, axis_lab, bar_title, values, look)

Arguments

cats

Character; the segments' categories, in order.

legend_title

Character(1) or NULL, as drawn.

axis_lab

Character; the bars' labels, as drawn.

bar_title

Character(1) or NULL; the title of the bars' axis.

values

Logical(1); whether the segments hold their values, whose text takes a color scale of its own.

look

A look.

Value

A list: scales (the chart's scale specs), tweak (the theme settings added after the look's theme) and title (the legend's title as it is drawn, or NULL).
